title: 電腦操作
description: 電腦使用與操作的常用表達

sentences.en: I need to restart my computer.
sentences.zh: 我需要重新啟動電腦。

sentences.en: How do I install this software?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼安裝這個軟體？

sentences.en: There's a system update available.
sentences.zh: 有一個系統更新可以安裝。

sentences.en: Can you help me find this file?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我找到這個檔案嗎？

sentences.en: I created a new folder on the desktop.
sentences.zh: 我在桌面建立了一個新資料夾。

sentences.en: Just copy and paste it here.
sentences.zh: 把它複製貼上到這裡就好。

sentences.en: The download is almost finished.
sentences.zh: 下載快要完成了。

sentences.en: My computer is running really slow today.
sentences.zh: 我的電腦今天跑得很慢。

sentences.en: I accidentally deleted an important file.
sentences.zh: 我不小心刪掉了一個重要檔案。

sentences.en: Let me check how much storage space is left.
sentences.zh: 讓我看看還剩多少儲存空間。

sentences.en: You should back up your files regularly.
sentences.zh: 你應該定期備份你的檔案。

sentences.en: I connected an external hard drive.
sentences.zh: 我接上了一顆外接硬碟。

sentences.en: Press Ctrl+S to save the document.
sentences.zh: 按 Ctrl+S 來儲存文件。

sentences.en: The keyboard shortcut makes it much faster.
sentences.zh: 鍵盤快捷鍵讓操作快很多。

sentences.en: I need to upgrade my RAM.
sentences.zh: 我需要升級我的記憶體。

sentences.en: Can you drag and drop the file into this folder?
sentences.zh: 你可以把檔案拖放到這個資料夾嗎？

sentences.en: I'm going to format this USB drive.
sentences.zh: 我要格式化這個 USB 隨身碟。

sentences.en: My screen just went black.
sentences.zh: 我的螢幕突然變黑了。

sentences.en: Double-click the icon to open it.
sentences.zh: 雙擊圖示來開啟它。

sentences.en: I need to empty the recycle bin.
sentences.zh: 我需要清空資源回收桶。

sentences.en: The file is too large to send by email.
sentences.zh: 這個檔案太大，無法用電子郵件寄送。

sentences.en: I compressed the files into a zip folder.
sentences.zh: 我把檔案壓縮成一個 zip 資料夾。

sentences.en: You need to right-click to see more options.
sentences.zh: 你需要按右鍵才能看到更多選項。

sentences.en: My computer keeps freezing.
sentences.zh: 我的電腦一直當機。

sentences.en: I just plugged in my mouse and keyboard.
sentences.zh: 我剛接上了滑鼠和鍵盤。

sentences.en: The fan is making a weird noise.
sentences.zh: 風扇在發出奇怪的聲音。

sentences.en: Can you show me how to take a screenshot?
sentences.zh: 你能教我怎麼截圖嗎？

sentences.en: I set up a second monitor for work.
sentences.zh: 我為了工作設定了第二台螢幕。

sentences.en: Make sure to safely eject the USB before removing it.
sentences.zh: 拔掉 USB 之前記得先安全退出。

sentences.en: I renamed the file so it's easier to find.
sentences.zh: 我把檔案重新命名，這樣比較好找。
